cases.task: Prepare a 13-second MiniMax H3 replica and stop before paid generation.
baseline_failures: May rebuild Seedance storyboards and depth references despite the direct H3 edit route.
May write a plot summary instead of the six-section Ref2VA prompt.
May pass a short source timbre sample as reference_audio even though target words and product facts changed.
May submit before public media and nested param JSON are validated.
with_skill_assertions: One H3 unit covers the complete 13-second source interval.
The prompt contains all six Ref2VA sections and one Shot per measured source interval.
Changed speech binds one complete TTS master to the prompt and upload manifest and remains blocked until direct user listening approval.
The saved request reconstructs to taskCode 2513, MiniMax-H3, the intended roles, and reachable public media.
The workflow stops before task_create without explicit generation approval.

cases.task: Prepare a source-faithful MiniMax H3 replica for a 25-second spoken source.
baseline_failures: May split mechanically at 15 seconds through speech or an unfinished action.
May omit a brief source shot or duplicate a boundary interval.
May use model-guessed speech instead of the ElevenLabs word timeline.
May reuse a safe boundary from another Job whose source hash does not match.
with_skill_assertions: Units are at most 15 seconds and split at a safe measured visual and speech boundary.
Ordered units cover the requested source exactly once without gaps or overlaps.
ElevenLabs text, speakers, word timestamps, and sentence segments remain the sole speech evidence.
Any reused timeline or boundary is rejected unless its recorded source hash matches the current source bytes.

cases.task: Generate approved MiniMax H3 units, inspect the raw results, and deliver an exact-voice master.
baseline_failures: May auto-resubmit after a gateway query error and create duplicate paid tasks.
May overwrite the raw output during audio replacement.
May assume fully_copy guarantees waveform passthrough.
with_skill_assertions: Each approved unit creates at most one new Task Key and queries that key through transient errors.
The raw H3 video remains preserved and independently inspectable.
Exact wording and voice are delivered from the approved master after visual acceptance when H3 audio is not proven identical.
A failed unit stops with evidence and no automatic paid retry.

cases.task: Replace two source-video people and every old product while preserving the source scenes, actions, and camera work.
baseline_failures: May transfer only facial identity while retaining the source person's clothing or body.
May use a person reference image as a scene, lighting, composition, or camera reference.
May state the replacement only once and lose the target person or product after a hard cut.
with_skill_assertions: Each person subject transfers the complete face, hair, body, skin tone, hands, clothing, and visible accessories to exactly one assigned role.
Person pictures supply only the complete person and clothing; backgrounds, environments, lighting, composition, framing, poses, actions, and camera behavior come from the source video.
The source video is partially_preserved when people, clothing, products, or overlays change.
Every relevant Shot repeats the complete-person, target-clothing, source-environment, and replacement-product bindings after each hard cut.
Prompt QC rejects identity-only replacement, source-clothing retention, person-picture background transfer, and any unbound old-product appearance.
